name: Kyeongin Hong
intro: I study combinatorial optimization, with a particular interest in combinatorial structure and polyhedral methods.
about: I received my B.S. in Industrial Engineering from Seoul National University. I currently work as a research engineer at ENERZAi, optimizing machine-learning inference.
background: Alongside my computational work, I have studied combinatorics and matroid theory in faculty-guided reading seminars with Professor Boram Park.

interests.title: LP formulations
interests.text: Using combinatorial structure to construct and strengthen linear programming relaxations.

interests.title: Integrality and exactness
interests.text: Understanding when a relaxation is integral, or exact for a given objective.

interests.title: Approximation algorithms
interests.text: Analyzing fractional extreme points to obtain provable guarantees.
